slides.headline: You do not need to train *every day*.
slides.body: Packing your movement into one or two sessions was linked to lower heart risk just like daily workouts.

slides.headline: Total weekly movement tracked with *lower risk*.
slides.body: People who squeezed workouts into a couple days showed similar lower death rates.

slides.headline: Blood sugar health showed the *same pattern*.
slides.body: Getting enough movement in fewer days was linked to lower long term health risks.

slides.headline: Hit your weekly goal *on your schedule*.
slides.body: Total weekly movement matters. Squeeze it into your weekend or spread it across the week.

caption: New evidence shows that packing your weekly workouts into one or two days is linked to the same heart and longevity benefits as spreading them out.
